mentions.name: Medusa's Gaze
mentions.description: A 3D first-person puzzle game in which Medusa turns the player to stone; the statue left behind persists after respawn and is used as a mechanic to solve the game's puzzles.
mentions.source_excerpt: My first video game! It's a 3D First Person Puzzle game where Medusa turns you to stone, but your statue remains when you respawn - and you use this to solve the puzzles in the game
